transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 526 Lochshin Drive?
Yes, this is 526 Lochshin Drive. Just me and my partner here, no water inside, and we’re safe.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are two people here, and neither of them can’t come to the phone.

I heard you, thank you for sharing that. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I just want to clarify — there’s no wheelchair or anyone bedbound.
Understood, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, there’s no water inside the home. Just to clarify, it’s 526 Lochshin Drive.
Got it, no water inside at 526 Lochshin Drive. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No water inside, and I don’t have a truck, boat, or any free seats to offer.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — two people, no water inside yet. Just to clarify, I’m safe and no one needs to be left alone.
I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
